data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and whenever stock is 500. With 25 fishers, total catch is 250, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That yields each of us $10,000 per month indefinitely if maintained. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state your intended cap; revealed catches will let us assess adherence.
